purpose: Observe the identical supplied Throwable caught inside a Generator body after Fiber suspension, finally before its first yield, and independent normal Generator/Fiber completion.
source:
<?php
function GeneratorFiberHandled53() {
    global $given;
    echo 'G|';
    try {
        $value = Fiber::suspend('pause53');
        echo 'NORMAL|', $value, '|';
    } catch (Exception $caught) {
        echo 'INNER|', (int) ($caught === $given), '|';
        echo (int) ($caught->getPrevious() === null), '|';
    } finally {
        echo 'FINALLY|';
    }
    yield 'yield53';
    echo 'AFTER-YIELD|';
    return 73;
}
$given = new Exception('supplied53');
$g = GeneratorFiberHandled53();
$f = new Fiber(function () {
    global $g;
    echo 'CALL|';
    $current = $g->current();
    echo 'CURRENT|', $current, '|';
    return 'done53';
});
echo 'START|', $f->start(), '|';
echo 'PAUSED|', (int) $f->isSuspended(), '|';
echo 'THROW|';
$reply = $f->throw($given);
echo 'DELIVERED|', (int) ($reply === null), '|';
echo 'DONE|', (int) $f->isTerminated(), '|', $f->getReturn(), '|';
echo 'VALID|', (int) $g->valid(), '|';
$g->next();
echo 'CLOSED|', (int) $g->valid(), '|', $g->getReturn(), '|';
echo 'GIVEN|', (int) ($given->getPrevious() === null), '|';
unset($f, $g, $given);
echo 'E';
